name: length
summary: Length of a string (codepoints), array (elements) or object (keys); absolute value of a number; 0 for null.

name: keys
summary: An object's keys, sorted, as an array; for an array, its indices.

name: keys_unsorted
summary: An object's keys in insertion order.

name: map
summary: Runs f on every element of an array and collects the results: same as `[.[] | f]`.
body: On an object it maps the values and returns an array; use `map_values` to keep an object.

name: map_values
summary: Runs f on every value, keeping the shape: an object stays an object.
body: If f outputs nothing for a value, that key is removed (1.7).

name: select
summary: Outputs the input unchanged if f is true for it, otherwise nothing.

name: to_entries
summary: An object as an array of `{"key": k, "value": v}`.
body: `from_entries` reverses it (it also accepts name/k/Key and value/v/Value); `with_entries(f)` is `to_entries | map(f) | from_entries`.

name: from_entries
summary: Builds an object from an array of key/value entries.

name: with_entries
summary: Edits an object through its entries: `to_entries | map(f) | from_entries`.

name: sort_by
summary: Sorts an array by the value of f on each element (stable).
body: Several keys: `sort_by(.a, .b)`. `sort` sorts by jq's ordering of values.

name: group_by
summary: Groups an array's elements by f into an array of arrays, sorted by f.

name: unique_by
summary: Keeps one element per distinct value of f, sorted by f.

name: add
summary: Adds up an array's elements with `+`: numbers sum, strings and arrays concatenate, objects merge. null for an empty array.

name: has
summary: Whether an object has the key (or an array has the index).

name: in
summary: Whether the input key is in object x: `"a" | in({"a":1})`.

name: split
summary: Splits a string on a separator string into an array.
body: With two arguments, `split(regex; flags)` splits on a regex.

name: join
summary: Joins an array of strings (numbers, booleans and null are converted; null becomes "") with a separator.

name: test
summary: Whether a string matches a regex.
body: Flags: `x` extended, `i` case-insensitive, `g` global, and others.

name: sub
summary: Replaces the first match of a regex. The replacement can use named captures: `\(.name)`.

name: gsub
summary: Replaces every match of a regex.

name: tostring
summary: A string as itself; anything else as its JSON text.

name: tonumber
summary: Parses a string as a number; numbers pass through.

name: type
summary: The input's type as a string: null, boolean, number, string, array or object.

name: empty
summary: Outputs nothing.
body: Handy in conditionals: `if .ok then . else empty end`.

name: error
summary: Raises an error, which `try` can catch.

name: try
summary: Runs exp; if it raises, runs handler on the error message (or outputs nothing without `catch`).

name: reduce
summary: Folds SOURCE's outputs into one value: starts from INIT, runs UPDATE with `.` as the running value and $x as the next item.

name: foreach
summary: Like reduce, but outputs EXTRACT after every step.

name: if
signature: if COND then A elif C2 then B else C end
summary: Conditional; only false and null count as false.
Alternative: a's outputs that aren't false or null; b if there are none.
Update-assignment: replaces the value at each path with f run on it.
Assignment: sets each path to value (computed from the original input).

name: @csv
summary: Formats an array as a CSV line (strings quoted).
body: Use with `-r` to get raw text.

name: @tsv
summary: Formats an array as a tab-separated line.

name: @base64
summary: Base64-encodes a string; `@base64d` decodes.

name: $ENV
summary: An object of the environment variables.
body: `$ENV.HOME`; `env` is the same as a function.

name: utf8bytelength
summary: A string's length in UTF-8 bytes.

name: match
summary: Match objects for a regex: offset, length, string, captures.

name: capture
summary: An object of a regex's named captures.

name: ascii_upcase
summary: A string with ASCII letters upper-cased; `ascii_downcase` lowers them.
